articles.title: India and ASEAN Finalize Framework for Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) Integration
articles.summary: India and ASEAN member nations signed a milestone agreement to integrate cross-border digital payment mechanisms and digital identity verification models.
prelims: Cross-border interoperability between UPI and ASEAN payment switches.
Key pillars of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI): Identity, Payments, and Data Exchange.
ASEAN-India Digital Work Plan priorities for regional economic connectivity.
articles.mains: Examine how Digital Diplomacy enhances India's Act East Policy and deepens economic integration with Southeast Asian nations.

articles.title: RBI Issues Mandatory Climate Risk Disclosures Framework for Commercial Banks
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has mandated standardized climate-related financial disclosures and stress-testing mechanisms for all Scheduled Commercial Banks.
prelims: Four pillar framework: Governance, Strategy, Risk Management, and Metrics/Targets.
Concept of Green Taxonomy and transition finance mechanisms.
Role of the Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS) in central banking.
articles.mains: Discuss the role of central banks in mitigating financial instability arising from physical and transition risks of climate change.

articles.title: ISRO Successfully Demonstrates Automated In-Orbit Docking Technology
articles.summary: ISRO achieved a critical technological milestone with the successful automated rendezvous and docking of two experimental satellites under the SPADEX program.
prelims: Objectives of the Space Docking Experiment (SPADEX).
Significance of autonomous docking for the proposed Bharatiya Antariksh Station (BAS).
Difference between active and passive satellite docking systems.
articles.mains: Evaluate India's technological readiness and strategic imperatives for establishing an autonomous permanent space station.

articles.title: Union Health Ministry Expands Financial Coverage for Rare Diseases under PM-JAY
articles.summary: The central government extended enhanced financial coverage under PM-JAY to cover treatment for specialized rare diseases across recognized Centres of Excellence.
prelims: Classification of Rare Diseases (Group 1, 2, and 3) under the National Policy for Rare Diseases.
Definition and regulatory provisions for 'Orphan Drugs' in India.
Role of Designated Centres of Excellence (CoE) in tertiary healthcare.
articles.mains: Analyze the socio-economic burden of rare diseases in India and assess recent policy measures aimed at improving affordable healthcare access.

articles.title: NDMA Rolls Out Integrated Early Warning System for High-Risk Himalayan Glacial Lakes
articles.summary: The National Disaster Management Authority deployed automated sensor networks and satellite monitoring for high-risk glacial lakes across the Himalayan region.
prelims: Causative factors behind Glacial Lake Outburst Floods (GLOFs).
Application of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery in monitoring glacial retreat.
NDMA guidelines on non-structural risk mitigation measures for flash floods.
articles.mains: Critically analyze the vulnerability of the Himalayan ecosystem to climate-induced disasters and suggest sustainable risk mitigation strategies.
